To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
water mediated synthesis of 2-aminoisopropyl pyrimidines is a green protocol, and the saturated compounds (i.e. 3) showed better anti- bacterial activity.
a library of pyrimidines has been synthesized using water as the green medium, and some of them showed high anti-bacterial activity.

the saturated compounds (compounds 3) rather than the corresponding unsaturated analogues 4 showed better anti-bacterials activity against the growth of three human pathogens viz., Staphylococus aureus, Klebseilla pneumonia and Escherchia coli.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new ecofriendly and water-mediated protocol for the synthesis of a library 2-amino pyrimidines, and the evaluation of the anti-bacterial activity of the newly synthesized compounds.
the synthesis of a series of 2-arylidene-6-aryl-2-amino-4, 6-dihydro pyrimidines and a series of 6-aryl-4, 5, 6, 7-tetrahydro pyrimidin-2-amine derivatives using a water mediated protocol.
the synthesis of 2-amidopyrimidines (3 &4) in a single pot, in a water assisted environment, using inexpensive reagents and mild conditions, which are also amenable to scale-up.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the saturated 2-amino-substituted pyrimidines are more active than the corresponding unsaturated compounds.
the saturated pyrimidines are more potent than the unsaturated analogs.
a water-mediated, eco-friendly protocol for the synthesis of 2-amno-6-stylyl pyrimidin-5(4H)-ones (3) and (4), and their in vitro biological activities, have been reported.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the present protocol has been found to be a greener, eco-friendly, water-mediated and efficient approach for the synthesis of 2-amono-6-stylyl pyrimidin-4(3H)-one derivatives and their dihydro-analogues.
the present methodology provides an efficient, green and eco-friendly protocol for the synthesis of a variety of 2-amidopyrimidine derivatives in good to excellent yields.
this is a greener protocol for the synthesis of a library (3 &4) of 2- amino-6-stylyl pyrimidin-4(3H)-ones and their dihydro-analogues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple water mediated protocol can be used for the efficient synthesis and screening of a library of compounds with potential bioactivity.
the saturated compounds (i.e. dihydro analogues) are more active against the tested bacteria.
the saturated compounds are better anti-bacterial agents compared to their unsaturated analogs.
